fire.order: grid order A1..A8 (top row L->R, then bottom row)
fire.placement: draw the cell so base_centre_px sits on the anchor x, its bottom row 1 painting px below the anchor y (anchor + 1 px * sy)
fire.alpha: straight RGBA: a = keyed brightness; canvas 'lighter' reproduces the black-keyed look, no premultiply needed
fire.dpr3_note: B1 cell width 74 px = 24.5 css at 390 = 1 atlas px per device px at DPR 3
